verdict.rationale: Weave documents a public Weave Service API with REST endpoints for programmatic access (docs-15) and a dedicated OTLP ingestion endpoint (docs-14, docs-41). Its Python/TypeScript SDK (docs-4) lets users drive tracing and evaluations programmatically. The OpenAPI probe only shows the spec is absent at the candidate paths; that does not contradict the documented REST API. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence of endpoint coverage and depth beyond a one-line reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
